name: ExecutiveKPI
description: KPI cards with target attainment, change versus previous, status colour and a trend sparkline.
lede: One card per KPI with target progress, movement and a trend line so leaders see status at a glance.

roles.name: kpi
roles.help: Creates one card per value. Leave empty for a single overall card.

roles.name: actual
roles.help: The current value of the KPI.

roles.name: target
roles.help: Goal to compare against; drives the status colour.

roles.name: previous
roles.help: Shows change versus the previous period.

roles.name: period
roles.help: Date or period used to draw the sparkline and pick the latest value.

steps: Add Target and Previous period to unlock status and change.
Add a KPI name to get one card per KPI.
Add a Trend axis (date) to draw sparklines and use the latest period.

faq.q: How is the status colour chosen?
faq.a: Attainment is Actual divided by Target. Green and amber thresholds are in the Format pane.

faq.q: What if lower is better (e.g. cost)?
faq.a: Turn on Lower is better in the KPI card of the Format pane.
